name: Belize (unofficial flag, 1950–1981)
description: A dark blue field with a white disc in the centre bearing the coat of arms of British Honduras within a wreath of fifty green leaves.
history: Unofficial flag of British Honduras flown by the People's United Party and the independence movement from 1950, the year the party came to power, which the fifty leaves of the wreath commemorate. When Belize became independent on 21 September 1981 the design, with red stripes added at top and bottom, became the basis of the national flag.

features.role: coat of arms of British Honduras
